Issue Reported: Urban Blood Draw- In an effort to reduce blood volume nursing added labs ordered by Dr. Anderson to be analyzed from the Urban blood collection by UTMB Clinical Laboratories.
Description of Action Taken: This modification was reported in the Daily Tag as a draw without additional volume. The additional volume in the Urban draw is picked up from UTMB Clinical Laboratories by Urban laboratory personnel for their continued use. It was not clear to the COD that research volumes were redirected for clinical purposes. Nursing was reeducated by their supervisor as to the separate purpose and protocols for medical purposes versus research. The two types of collections and processes are to be kept separate. They can be drawn at the same draw but not in the same tube. No changes to research blood draws should occur without consulting the Sample Coordinator and COD with all of the details. Dr. Urbans lab was contacted for impacts by the Sample Coordinator. No impacts are expected at this time.
Disposition Comments: Attending physician ordered follow up blood draw to check Mg levels.
